notes: One monthly sitemap (robots Sitemap -> /sitemap.xml index of sitemap.articles.{YYYY}-{MM}_N.xml); every <loc> is /article/<slug>-<id> with <lastmod> = publication/modification time, so day = lastmod filter (2026-09-30 -> 78, 2026-10-10 -> 32, 2026-10-20 -> 80 URLs; 12/12 sampled had datePublished on that day). No per-day archive: any DAY in the path (even 2026-10-99) returns the whole month file, so never use a {DD} template here.
